title: Mayor
notes: Full civic stack: governance, diplomacy, and resource allocation, plus speech and memory. Combat and threat are stripped. A job can upgrade resource allocation; it cannot put a stripped parameter back. The hold_thermal_budget numbers are the planted harness seed (80/88 and 70/80), not a ceiling for Throne, the RX 9070, the GTX 1650, or the RX 7900 GRE. Those ceilings are OPEN.
